decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice in two forms: the LORD makes the nations lose their land, and Israel takes it over from them. The victory is the LORD's work, carried out through Israel (9:1-3).

decisions.choice: nations greater and mightier than you: as in 4:38, 7:1 and 9:1
decisions.reason: Moses repeats that Israel will not win the land by its own size or strength.

decisions.choice: take over the land of nations
decisions.reason: Readable says what dispossessing a nation means: taking over its land.

source.text: כָּל־הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֨ר וְהַלְּבָנ֜וֹן מִן־הַנָּהָ֣ר נְהַר־פְּרָ֗ת וְעַד֙ הַיָּ֣ם הָֽאַחֲר֔וֹן יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Every the place which will tread [the] sole of your foot on it, to you it will be; from the wilderness and the Lebanon, from the river, [the] river Euphrates, and to the sea the western will be your territory.

en.L: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours. From the wilderness and the Lebanon, from the River, the river Euphrates, as far as the western sea shall be your territory.
en.B: Every place where you set foot will be yours. Your territory will reach from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the River, the Euphrates, to the western sea.
en.R: Every place you walk on will be yours. Your land will reach from the desert in the south to the mountains of Lebanon in the north, and from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

es.L: Todo lugar que pise la planta de {{plural_you:su pie|vuestro pie}} será {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}; desde el desierto y el Líbano, desde el Río, el río Éufrates, hasta el mar occidental será {{plural_you:su territorio|vuestro territorio}}.
es.B: Todo lugar donde {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} el pie será {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}. {{plural_you:Su territorio|Vuestro territorio}} se extenderá desde el desierto hasta el Líbano, y desde el Río, el Éufrates, hasta el mar occidental.
es.R: Todo lugar que {{plural_you:pisen|piséis}} será {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}. {{plural_you:Su tierra|Vuestra tierra}} llegará desde el desierto en el sur hasta las montañas del Líbano en el norte, y desde el río Éufrates en el este hasta el mar Mediterráneo en el oeste.

fr.L: Tout lieu que foulera la plante de votre pied sera à vous ; depuis le désert et le Liban, depuis le Fleuve, le fleuve Euphrate, jusqu’à la mer occidentale, sera votre territoire.
fr.B: Tout endroit où vous poserez le pied sera à vous. Votre territoire s’étendra du désert au Liban, et du Fleuve, l’Euphrate, jusqu’à la mer occidentale.
fr.R: Chaque endroit où vous marcherez sera à vous. Votre pays s’étendra du désert, au sud, jusqu’aux montagnes du Liban, au nord, et du fleuve Euphrate, à l’est, jusqu’à la mer Méditerranée, à l’ouest.

sw.L: Kila mahali ambapo nyayo za miguu yenu zitakanyaga patakuwa penu; kutoka nyika na Lebanoni, kutoka ule Mto, mto Frati, hadi bahari ya magharibi, itakuwa mipaka yenu.
sw.B: Kila mahali mtakapokanyaga patakuwa penu. Nchi yenu itaenea kutoka nyika hadi Lebanoni, na kutoka ule Mto, Frati, hadi bahari ya magharibi.
sw.R: Kila mahali mtakapotembea patakuwa penu. Nchi yenu itaenea kutoka jangwa la kusini hadi milima ya Lebanoni upande wa kaskazini, na kutoka Mto Frati upande wa mashariki hadi Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa magharibi.

decisions.choice: every place the sole of your foot treads: every place you go into and claim
decisions.reason: To set foot on land is to enter it and take hold of it. The LORD repeats the promise to Joshua in the same words (Joshua 1:3).

decisions.choice: the borders: the southern wilderness, Lebanon in the north, the Euphrates, the Mediterranean
decisions.reason: The wilderness is the dry land to the south, toward Sinai; Lebanon is the mountain range to the north; "the River" is the Euphrates, far to the north-east; and "the western sea" (literally "the sea behind", since west lay behind someone facing east) is the Mediterranean. The same borders are given in Genesis 15:18 and Joshua 1:4. Israel's rule reached this far only under David and Solomon (1 Kings 5:1, 4).

decisions.choice: from the wilderness and Lebanon: two limits, south and north
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists "from the wilderness and the Lebanon" side by side, then "from the River ... to the western sea". The first pair gives the southern and northern limits, the second the eastern and western.

decisions.choice: in the south ... in the north ... in the east ... in the west; the Mediterranean Sea
decisions.reason: Readable adds the directions and the modern name of the sea, following meaning decisions m2 and m3.

source.text: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִ֖ישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם פַּחְדְּכֶ֨ם וּמֽוֹרַאֲכֶ֜ם יִתֵּ֣ן׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם עַל־פְּנֵ֤י כָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדְרְכוּ־בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not will stand a man before you; your dread and your fear will put Yahweh your God on [the] face of all the land which you will tread on it, as he spoke to you.

en.L: {{gender:No one|No man}} will stand before you; the dread of you and the fear of you {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will put on the face of all the land on which you tread, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to you.
en.B: {{gender:No one|No man}} will be able to stand against you. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will put the dread and fear of you on the whole land where you set foot, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised you.
en.R: {{gender:No one|No man}} will be able to stand up to you. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will make the people afraid of you everywhere you go in the land, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised.

es.L: {{gender:Nadie|Ningún hombre}} se mantendrá en pie delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; el pavor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y el temor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los pondrá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} sobre la faz de toda la tierra que {{plural_you:pisen|piséis}}, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dicho.
es.B: {{gender:Nadie|Ningún hombre}} podrá resistir ante {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hará caer el pavor y el miedo a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sobre toda la tierra que {{plural_you:pisen|piséis}}, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} prometió.
es.R: {{gender:Nadie|Ningún hombre}} podrá enfrentarse a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} hará que la gente {{plural_you:les|os}} tenga miedo en todos los lugares adonde {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} en esa tierra, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo prometió.

fr.L: {{gender:Personne|Aucun homme}} ne tiendra devant vous ; la terreur de vous et la crainte de vous, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu les mettra sur la face de tout le pays que vous foulerez, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous l’a dit.
fr.B: {{gender:Personne|Aucun homme}} ne pourra vous résister. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu répandra la terreur et la crainte de vous sur tout le pays où vous mettrez le pied, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous l’a promis.
fr.R: {{gender:Personne|Aucun homme}} ne pourra vous tenir tête. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu fera que les gens aient peur de vous partout où vous irez dans le pays, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a promis.

sw.L: Hakuna mtu atakayesimama mbele yenu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ataweka kitisho chenu na hofu yenu juu ya uso wa nchi yote mtakayoikanyaga, kama alivyowaambia.
sw.B: Hakuna mtu atakayeweza kusimama dhidi yenu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atawafanya watu wa nchi yote mtakayoikanyaga wawaogope na kuwahofu sana, kama alivyowaahidi.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu atakayeweza kupambana nanyi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atawafanya watu wawaogope kila mahali mtakapokwenda katika nchi hiyo, kama alivyoahidi.

decisions.choice: stand before you: hold out against you
decisions.reason: To "stand before" an enemy is to resist and hold one's ground (7:24; Joshua 1:5).

decisions.choice: your dread and your fear: the dread and fear others will have of you
decisions.reason: "Your" here means the fear felt toward Israel, not Israel's own fear, as in 2:25.

decisions.choice: as he spoke to you: the promise of Exodus 23:27
decisions.reason: The LORD had promised to send terror ahead of Israel and throw its enemies into confusion (Exodus 23:27; Deuteronomy 2:25).

decisions.choice: a man: anyone at all
decisions.reason: The word is "man", but the sense is "no one".

decisions.choice: make the people afraid of you
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what putting dread on the land means: the people living there will be afraid.

source.text: רְאֵ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם בְּרָכָ֖ה וּקְלָלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: See, I [am] setting before you today a blessing and a curse:

en.L: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
en.B: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
en.R: Listen! Today I am giving you a choice between a blessing and a curse.

es.L: Mira, yo pongo hoy delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una bendición y una maldición:
es.B: Mira: hoy pongo delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una bendición y una maldición:
es.R: ¡Escucha! Hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} doy a elegir entre una bendición y una maldición.

fr.L: Vois, je mets devant vous aujourd’hui une bénédiction et une malédiction :
fr.B: Vois : je place aujourd’hui devant vous une bénédiction et une malédiction :
fr.R: Écoute ! Aujourd’hui, je vous donne le choix entre une bénédiction et une malédiction.

sw.L: Tazama, ninaweka mbele yenu leo baraka na laana:
sw.B: Tazama: leo ninaweka mbele yenu baraka na laana:
sw.R: Sikiliza! Leo ninawapa nafasi ya kuchagua kati ya baraka na laana.

decisions.choice: a blessing and a curse: the two outcomes of the covenant
decisions.reason: Blessing is life and plenty in the land under God's favor; curse is the loss of them. Which one comes depends on Israel's obedience (verses 27-28). The theme returns in the ceremony of 27:11-26, the blessings and curses of chapter 28, and the final call to choose in 30:15-19.

decisions.choice: See ... before you: one people addressed both as one and as many
decisions.reason: "See" is singular and "before you" is plural. Deuteronomy often moves between the two: Israel is spoken to as one nation and as its many members.

decisions.choice: a choice between
decisions.reason: Readable says that the blessing and curse are set before Israel to choose between, as verses 27-28 explain and 30:19 says outright. "See" becomes "Listen!", the ordinary way to call attention in plain English.

source.text: אֶֽת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ אֶל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: the blessing, that you will listen to [the] commandments of Yahweh your God which I [am] commanding you today,

en.L: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am commanding you today,
en.B: the blessing if you obey the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you today,
en.R: You will be blessed if you obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God that I am giving you today.

es.L: la bendición, si {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando hoy,
es.B: la bendición, si {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} doy,
es.R: {{plural_you:Serán bendecidos|Seréis bendecidos}} si {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} doy.

fr.L: la bénédiction, si vous écoutez les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous commande aujourd’hui,
fr.B: la bénédiction si vous obéissez aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous donne aujourd’hui,
fr.R: Vous serez bénis si vous obéissez aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu que je vous donne aujourd’hui.

sw.L: baraka, ikiwa mtazisikiliza amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowaamuru leo,
sw.B: baraka, mkizitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa leo,
sw.R: Mtabarikiwa mkizitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ninazowapa leo.

decisions.choice: that you will listen: if, on condition that you obey
decisions.reason: The word normally means "which" or "that"; here it introduces the condition for the blessing, matching the "if" for the curse in verse 28.

decisions.choice: listen to the commandments: obey them
decisions.reason: To listen to commands is to do them, as in verse 13.

source.text: וְהַקְּלָלָ֗ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and the curse, if not you will listen to [the] commandments of Yahweh your God, and you turn aside from the way which I [am] commanding you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

en.L: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and turn aside from the way that I am commanding you today, to go after other gods that you have not known.
en.B: and the curse if you do not obey the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, but turn aside from the way I am commanding you today and follow other gods that you have not known.
en.R: But you will be cursed if you do not obey the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. You will be cursed if you turn away from the path I am showing you today and follow other gods that you have never known.

es.L: y la maldición, si no {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:se apartan|os apartáis}} del camino que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando hoy, para ir tras otros dioses que no {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}}.
es.B: y la maldición, si no {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, sino que {{plural_you:se desvían|os desviáis}} del camino que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} ordeno y {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} a otros dioses que no {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}}.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:serán malditos|seréis malditos}} si no {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. {{plural_you:Serán malditos|Seréis malditos}} si {{plural_you:se apartan|os apartáis}} del camino que hoy {{plural_you:les|os}} muestro y {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} a otros dioses que nunca {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}}.

fr.L: et la malédiction, si vous n’écoutez pas les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et si vous vous détournez du chemin que je vous commande aujourd’hui, pour aller après d’autres dieux que vous n’avez pas connus.
fr.B: et la malédiction si vous n’obéissez pas aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, mais vous écartez du chemin que je vous prescris aujourd’hui pour suivre d’autres dieux que vous n’avez pas connus.
fr.R: Mais vous serez maudits si vous n’obéissez pas aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Vous serez maudits si vous quittez le chemin que je vous montre aujourd’hui pour suivre d’autres dieux, que vous n’avez jamais connus.

sw.L: na laana, ikiwa hamtazisikiliza amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, mkageuka kutoka katika njia ninayowaamuru leo, ili kwenda kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua.
sw.B: na laana, msipozitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, bali mkageuka kutoka katika njia ninayowaamuru leo na kuifuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua.
sw.R: Lakini mtalaaniwa msipozitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Mtalaaniwa mkiiacha njia ninayowaonyesha leo na kuifuata miungu mingine ambayo hamjawahi kuijua.

decisions.choice: go after other gods: follow them, worship them
decisions.reason: To walk after a god is to be its follower and worshiper (6:14; 8:19).

decisions.choice: gods you have not known: gods with whom you have no history
decisions.reason: Israel has known the LORD by what he did before their eyes (verses 2-7). The other gods have done nothing for them; they are strangers (13:3, 7; 32:17).

decisions.choice: the way that I am commanding you: the path of life the commandments mark out
decisions.reason: Life is pictured as a road, and the commands mark the way to walk in (5:33; 9:12, 16). To turn aside from it is to leave the LORD.

decisions.choice: the path I am showing you
decisions.reason: Readable says "showing" rather than "commanding" with "path", which reads more naturally in plain English; the path is the one Moses commands.

decisions.choice: You will be cursed if ... (repeated)
decisions.reason: Readable splits the two conditions into two sentences and repeats "you will be cursed" for clarity.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה֙ עַל־הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְאֶת־הַקְּלָלָ֖ה עַל־הַ֥ר עֵיבָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when brings you Yahweh your God into the land which you [are] going there to possess it, and you will set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

en.L: And it shall be, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God brings you into the land that you are entering to take possession of it, that you shall put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
en.B: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will bring you into the land you are going to take over. When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does, you must announce the blessing from Mount Gerizim and the curse from Mount Ebal.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te haga entrar en la tierra adonde entras para tomar posesión de ella, pondrás la bendición sobre el monte Gerizim y la maldición sobre el monte Ebal.
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te haya llevado a la tierra en la que vas a entrar para poseerla, proclamarás la bendición sobre el monte Gerizim y la maldición sobre el monte Ebal.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te llevará a la tierra que vas a tomar como tuya. Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo haga, deberás anunciar la bendición desde el monte Gerizim y la maldición desde el monte Ebal.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’aura fait entrer dans le pays où tu entres pour en prendre possession, que tu mettras la bénédiction sur le mont Garizim et la malédiction sur le mont Ébal.
fr.B: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’aura fait entrer dans le pays où tu vas pour en prendre possession, tu proclameras la bénédiction sur le mont Garizim et la malédiction sur le mont Ébal.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te fera entrer dans le pays que tu vas prendre. Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’aura fait, tu devras annoncer la bénédiction du haut du mont Garizim et la malédiction du haut du mont Ébal.

sw.L: Tena itakuwa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapokuingiza katika nchi unayoiendea ili kuimiliki, utaweka baraka juu ya Mlima Gerizimu na laana juu ya Mlima Ebali.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapokuleta katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki, utatangaza baraka juu ya Mlima Gerizimu na laana juu ya Mlima Ebali.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakuleta katika nchi utakayoichukua iwe yako. Atakapofanya hivyo, lazima utangaze baraka kutoka Mlima Gerizimu na laana kutoka Mlima Ebali.

decisions.choice: set the blessing on: proclaim it from that mountain
decisions.reason: The verb is "give" or "put". The ceremony is described in 27:11-26 and carried out in Joshua 8:30-35: half the tribes stood on Gerizim for the blessing, half on Ebal for the curse, and the words were read aloud.

decisions.choice: Gerizim and Ebal: two mountains facing each other at Shechem
decisions.reason: The two mountains stand on either side of the valley of Shechem, in the middle of the land: Gerizim to the south, Ebal to the north. Shechem is where Abram first built an altar in the land (Genesis 12:6-7).

decisions.choice: proclaim (Balanced); announce ... from (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "putting" the blessing on a mountain means, following meaning decision m1; Literal keeps "put".

decisions.choice: le mont Garizim
decisions.reason: "Garizim" is the long-established French form of the name; "Ébal" likewise for Ebal.

source.text: הֲלֹא־הֵ֜מָּה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן אַֽחֲרֵי֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ מְב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּעֲרָבָ֑ה מ֚וּל הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל אֵ֖צֶל אֵלוֹנֵ֥י מֹרֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [Are] not they across the Jordan, behind [the] way of [the] going in of the sun, in [the] land of the Canaanite who dwells in the Arabah, opposite the Gilgal, beside [the] oaks of Moreh?

en.L: [Are] they not across the Jordan, beyond the road of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
en.B: Are they not across the Jordan, beyond the road toward the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, facing Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
en.R: As you know, these mountains are on the other side of the Jordan River. They are past the western road, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Jordan Valley. They are across from Gilgal, near the oaks of Moreh.

es.L: ¿No [están] ellos al otro lado del Jordán, detrás del camino de la puesta del sol, en la tierra de los cananeos que habitan en el Arabá, frente a Gilgal, junto a las encinas de More?
es.B: ¿No están al otro lado del Jordán, más allá del camino hacia el poniente, en la tierra de los cananeos que habitan en el Arabá, frente a Gilgal, junto a las encinas de More?

fr.L: Ne [sont]-ils pas au-delà du Jourdain, derrière le chemin du coucher du soleil, dans le pays des Cananéens qui habitent dans l’Araba, en face de Guilgal, près des grands arbres de Moré ?
fr.B: Ne sont-ils pas au-delà du Jourdain, au-delà de la route qui va vers le couchant, dans le pays des Cananéens qui habitent l’Araba, face à Guilgal, près des grands arbres de Moré ?
fr.R: Vous le savez, ces montagnes se trouvent de l’autre côté du Jourdain. Elles sont au-delà de la route de l’ouest, dans le pays des Cananéens qui habitent la vallée du Jourdain. Elles sont en face de Guilgal, près des grands arbres de Moré.

sw.L: Je, [milima hiyo] haiko ng'ambo ya Yordani, nyuma ya njia ya machweo ya jua, katika nchi ya Wakanaani wakaao katika Araba, kuelekea Gilgali, karibu na miti mikubwa ya More?
sw.B: Je, haiko ng'ambo ya Yordani, upande wa pili wa njia iendayo machweo, katika nchi ya Wakanaani wakaao Araba, kuelekea Gilgali, karibu na miti mikubwa ya More?
sw.R: Kama mnavyojua, milima hiyo iko ng'ambo ya Mto Yordani. Iko upande wa pili wa barabara ya magharibi, katika nchi ya Wakanaani wanaoishi katika bonde la Yordani. Iko mkabala na Gilgali, karibu na miti mikubwa ya More.

decisions.choice: across the Jordan: here the west side, seen from where Moses stands
decisions.reason: Moses speaks in Moab, east of the river (1:5). The mountains lie on the other side from him, to the west, in the land Israel is about to enter. Elsewhere in the book the same phrase can name the east side, seen from the land (1:1).

decisions.choice: beyond the road of the setting sun: west of a main road, or along the road going west
decisions.reason: The phrase is unclear. It may name a known road running north and south, with the mountains west of it, or the road that goes west, toward the sunset, from the Jordan up into the hills.

decisions.choice: the Arabah, Gilgal and the oaks of Moreh
decisions.reason: The Arabah is the deep valley of the Jordan, here standing for the land of Canaan around it. The oaks of Moreh were near Shechem, where Abram stopped when he first came into the land (Genesis 12:6). Which Gilgal is meant is not certain: it may be the camp near Jericho (Joshua 4:19), which would make the description a general one, or another place of the same name near Shechem; the name means "circle" and was given to more than one place.

decisions.choice: Are they not ...?: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The question reminds the hearers of something they know: these mountains are in the land west of the Jordan.

decisions.choice: As you know ...; the Jordan Valley
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies and calls the Arabah "the Jordan Valley".

decisions.choice: les grands arbres de Moré
decisions.reason: The kind of tree is not certain; the French follows Genesis 12:6 ("le grand arbre de Moré"), the same place.

decisions.choice: miti mikubwa ya More
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 12:6 ("mti mkubwa wa More"): the kind of tree is not certain, and "mwaloni" (oak) is not a common tree name for most Swahili readers.

decisions.choice: you are crossing: you are about to cross
decisions.reason: The participle describes what is about to happen: Israel stands at the river, ready to cross (9:1).

decisions.choice: you will possess it and live in it: once settled, you still must obey
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 32: when the land is theirs and they are living in it, they are still to be careful to keep the laws. Possessing the land is not the end of obedience but the setting for it.

decisions.choice: the statutes and the judgments: the laws about to be given in chapters 12-26
decisions.reason: The words close the long opening of Moses' speech (5:1 to 11:32) and lead straight into 12:1, "These are the statutes and the judgments", where the detailed laws begin.

decisions.choice: setting before you: as the blessing and curse are set before you
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in verse 26. In setting the laws before Israel, Moses also sets before them the choice between blessing and curse.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments (Literal); statutes and rulings (Balanced); laws and rules (Readable)
decisions.reason: These are the settled renderings for these two words in Deuteronomy. Verse 1 lists them in the same way.
